svg.text: Each dot is one exploited vulnerability the sensors saw attacked today (199). Further right means more connections, higher up more distinct source
addresses; both scales are logarithmic. Dots low and far right are hammered by a few sources: 13 entries had over 1,000 connections from fewer
than 20 addresses, the most Fortinet FortiOS, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchMana (CVE-2022-40684: 16,731 connections from 16). Dots high up are
scanned broadly. Red carries the EUVD's UPTICK flag; a ring marks a surge as this monitor defines it (0 broad today). The numbered dots are listed
Limits: Connections and addresses as Shadowserver's sensors count them on one day. A few addresses can be one research scanner or one botnet node; many
addresses can be a botnet or a crowd of scanners. The chart shows how concentrated the traffic is, not who sent it or why.
This panel also carries a table, which the image does not include; it is on the page.
